selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve the imported tree and inventory

selected_evidence.requirement: Report collisions without overwrite or silently dropping a source
selected_evidence.summary: converted/plain.txt retained its original SHA-256 6b72446745ee7a234b08fe338eff93f718d7964918327d2d468fccf110940da8; imported/plain.txt retained its distinct source hash, and the collision is recorded in conversion-report.tsv.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 6ab6a71b-188c-48ae-971b-a6bb378b1d72; reboot acknowledgement was captured; node1 returned with boot ID 3f25ea2f-121a-4b4e-b0b5-50c4cec9aea7; final checks proved system health, enforcing SELinux, zero failed units, mounted data, preserved sources, collision record, and converted files.

commands.command:
set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
import errno, hashlib, os, stat, tempfile
base=b'/srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration'
src=os.path.join(base,b'imported')
dst=os.path.join(base,b'converted')
report=os.path.join(base,b'conversion-report.tsv')
if os.path.lexists(report):
    raise SystemExit('refusing to overwrite existing conversion report')
def mapped(rel):
    return b'/'.join(p.decode('latin-1').encode('utf-8') for p in rel.split(b'/'))
def digest(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path,'rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(131072),b''): h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()
def q(text):
    return text.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('\t','\\t').replace('\n','\\n')
rows=[]
blocked=[]
created_dirs=[]
for dp,dns,fns in os.walk(src,topdown=True):
    dns.sort(); fns.sort()
    rel_dp=os.path.relpath(dp,src)
    if rel_dp == b'.': rel_dp=b''
    kept=[]
    for name in dns:
        rel=os.path.join(rel_dp,name) if rel_dp else name
        tp=os.path.join(dst,mapped(rel))
        source_text=rel.decode('latin-1')
        target_text=mapped(rel).decode('utf-8')
        if os.path.lexists(tp):
            if stat.S_ISDIR(os.lstat(tp).st_mode):
                rows.append(('directory_merged',rel.hex(),source_text,target_text,'-','-'))
                kept.append(name)
            else:
                rows.append(('collision_non_directory_parent',rel.hex(),source_text,target_text,'-','-'))
                blocked.append(rel)
        else:
            st=os.stat(os.path.join(dp,name),follow_symlinks=False)
            os.mkdir(tp,stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode))
            os.chown(tp,st.st_uid,st.st_gid,follow_symlinks=False)
            created_dirs.append((tp,st))
            rows.append(('directory_created',rel.hex(),source_text,target_text,'-','-'))
            kept.append(name)
    dns[:]=kept
    for name in fns:
        sp=os.path.join(dp,name)
        rel=os.path.join(rel_dp,name) if rel_dp else name
        out_rel=mapped(rel); tp=os.path.join(dst,out_rel)
        source_text=rel.decode('latin-1'); target_text=out_rel.decode('utf-8')
        st=os.lstat(sp)
        if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
            rows.append(('unsupported_source_type',rel.hex(),source_text,target_text,'-','-'))
            print('UNSUPPORTED source_hex=%s target=%r' % (rel.hex(),target_text))
            continue
        src_hash=digest(sp)
        if os.path.lexists(tp):
            dst_hash=digest(tp) if stat.S_ISREG(os.lstat(tp).st_mode) else '-'
            rows.append(('collision_existing_destination',rel.hex(),source_text,target_text,src_hash,dst_hash))
            print('COLLISION source_hex=%s source=%r target=%r source_sha256=%s destination_sha256=%s' % (rel.hex(),source_text,target_text,src_hash,dst_hash))
            continue
        parent=os.path.dirname(tp)
        fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=b'.encoding-migration-',dir=parent)
        try:
            with open(sp,'rb') as inf, os.fdopen(fd,'wb',closefd=True) as outf:
                while True:
                    chunk=inf.read(131072)
                    if not chunk: break
                    outf.write(chunk)
                outf.flush(); os.fsync(outf.fileno())
            os.chmod(tmp,stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode),follow_symlinks=False)
            os.chown(tmp,st.st_uid,st.st_gid,follow_symlinks=False)
            os.utime(tmp,ns=(st.st_atime_ns,st.st_mtime_ns),follow_symlinks=False)
            try:
                os.link(tmp,tp,follow_symlinks=False)
            except FileExistsError:
                dst_hash=digest(tp) if stat.S_ISREG(os.lstat(tp).st_mode) else '-'
                rows.append(('collision_existing_destination',rel.hex(),source_text,target_text,src_hash,dst_hash))
                print('COLLISION source_hex=%s source=%r target=%r source_sha256=%s destination_sha256=%s' % (rel.hex(),source_text,target_text,src_hash,dst_hash))
                continue
            dst_hash=digest(tp)
            if dst_hash != src_hash:
                os.unlink(tp)
                raise RuntimeError('post-copy checksum mismatch for '+target_text)
            rows.append(('copied',rel.hex(),source_text,target_text,src_hash,dst_hash))
            print('COPIED source_hex=%s source=%r target=%r sha256=%s' % (rel.hex(),source_text,target_text,src_hash))
        finally:
            try: os.unlink(tmp)
            except FileNotFoundError: pass
for tp,st in reversed(created_dirs):
    os.chmod(tp,stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode),follow_symlinks=False)
    os.chown(tp,st.st_uid,st.st_gid,follow_symlinks=False)
    os.utime(tp,ns=(st.st_atime_ns,st.st_mtime_ns),follow_symlinks=False)
header='status\tsource_hex\tsource_latin1\ttarget_utf8\tsource_sha256\tdestination_sha256\n'
body=''.join('\t'.join(q(v) for v in row)+'\n' for row in rows)
fd=os.open(report,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o644)
with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:
    f.write((header+body).encode('utf-8')); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
print('REPORT %s entries=%d copied=%d collisions=%d' % (os.fsdecode(report),len(rows),sum(r[0]=='copied' for r in rows),sum(r[0].startswith('collision_') for r in rows)))
PY

import csv, hashlib, io, os, stat
base=b'/srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration'; src=base+b'/imported'; dst=base+b'/converted'
expected={
 b'caf\xe9.txt':'59f6d353275a6146b3b03834424fb0cad6fece8b4034ecab9f89da4109efa243',
 b'plain.txt':'0e114029a06a60a7ae6c677b208479866bafeecee1712c4100b06805bfdc63b4',

 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with open(p,'rb') as f:
  for c in iter(lambda:f.read(131072),b''): h.update(c)
 return h.hexdigest()
def entries(root):
 out=[]
 for dp,dns,fns in os.walk(root):
  dns.sort(); fns.sort()
  for n in dns+fns: out.append(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(dp,n),root))
 return out

 p=src+b'/'+rel; st=os.lstat(p)
 assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)==0o644 and st.st_uid==0 and st.st_gid==0
 got=sha(p); assert got==want,(rel,got,want)
 print('SOURCE_OK raw_hex=%s latin1=%r sha256=%s' % (rel.hex(),rel.decode('latin-1'),got))
converted_entries=entries(dst)
for rel in converted_entries:
 rel.decode('utf-8')
 assert not any(part.startswith(b'.encoding-migration-') for part in rel.split(b'/'))

for raw,want in sorted(expected.items()):
 target=b'/'.join(p.decode('latin-1').encode('utf-8') for p in raw.split(b'/'))
 tp=dst+b'/'+target
 assert os.path.lexists(tp)
 got=sha(tp)
 if raw==b'plain.txt':
  assert got=='6b72446745ee7a234b08fe338eff93f718d7964918327d2d468fccf110940da8'

 else:

text=data.decode('utf-8'); rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text),delimiter='\t'))

assert sum(r['status']=='copied' for r in rows)==2
coll=[r for r in rows if r['status']=='collision_existing_destination']

assert coll[0]['source_sha256']==expected[b'plain.txt']

assert sha(base+b'/inventory.txt')=='9ab4a43fd1f6762626066b004fa17d65daa3a6f7a8ea39f5e9721359d80dd99f'

set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration
old_boot=6ab6a71b-188c-48ae-971b-a6bb378b1d72
new_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
[ "$new_boot" != "$old_boot" ]
printf 'BOOT_CHANGED old=%s new=%s\n' "$old_boot" "$new_boot"
printf '%s\n' '[platform-post-restart]'
sed -n 's/^PRETTY_NAME=//p' /etc/os-release
uname -r
rpm -q python3 coreutils glibc
printf '%s\n' '[system-health-post-restart]'
systemctl is-system-running
failed=$(systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain)
[ -z "$failed" ]
printf '%s\n' 'FAILED_UNITS=0'
[ "$(getenforce)" = Enforcing ]
printf '%s\n' 'SELINUX=Enforcing'
findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS -T "$base"
printf '%s\n' '[strict-tree-verification-post-restart]'
python3 - <<'PY'
import csv, hashlib, io, os, stat
base=b'/srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration'; src=base+b'/imported'; dst=base+b'/converted'
expected={
 b'caf\xe9.txt':'59f6d353275a6146b3b03834424fb0cad6fece8b4034ecab9f89da4109efa243',
 b'plain.txt':'0e114029a06a60a7ae6c677b208479866bafeecee1712c4100b06805bfdc63b4',
 b'r\xe9sum\xe9.txt':'9712e6ef87b39863c66daff1d948f4e0f6684f290a2882ba9eb6780b9e6ed51f'}
old_destination_hash='6b72446745ee7a234b08fe338eff93f718d7964918327d2d468fccf110940da8'
def sha(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with open(p,'rb') as f:
  for c in iter(lambda:f.read(131072),b''): h.update(c)
 return h.hexdigest()
def entries(root):
 out=[]
 for dp,dns,fns in os.walk(root):
  dns.sort(); fns.sort()
  for n in dns+fns: out.append(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(dp,n),root))
 return out
source_entries=entries(src)
assert set(source_entries)==set(expected)
expected_dest=set()
for raw,want in sorted(expected.items()):
 sp=src+b'/'+raw; st=os.lstat(sp)
 assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)==0o644 and (st.st_uid,st.st_gid)==(0,0)
 assert sha(sp)==want
 target=b'/'.join(p.decode('latin-1').encode('utf-8') for p in raw.split(b'/'))
 target.decode('utf-8'); expected_dest.add(target)
 tp=dst+b'/'+target
 assert os.path.lexists(tp)
 dst_st=os.lstat(tp)
 assert stat.S_ISREG(dst_st.st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(dst_st.st_mode)==0o644 and (dst_st.st_uid,dst_st.st_gid)==(0,0)
 got=sha(tp)
 if raw==b'plain.txt':
  assert got==old_destination_hash and got!=want
  print('COLLISION_SURVIVED_RESTART source_hex=%s target=%r source_sha256=%s preserved_destination_sha256=%s' % (raw.hex(),target.decode('utf-8'),want,got))
 else:
  assert got==want
  print('CONVERSION_SURVIVED_RESTART source_hex=%s target=%r content_sha256=%s' % (raw.hex(),target.decode('utf-8'),got))
dest_entries=entries(dst)
assert set(dest_entries)==expected_dest,(dest_entries,expected_dest)
for rel in dest_entries:
 rel.decode('utf-8')
 assert not any(part.startswith(b'.encoding-migration-') for part in rel.split(b'/'))
print('DESTINATION_TREE_EXACT_AND_UTF8 entries=%d' % len(dest_entries))
with open(base+b'/conversion-report.tsv','rb') as f: report_bytes=f.read()
report_text=report_bytes.decode('utf-8')
rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(report_text),delimiter='\t'))
assert len(rows)==3 and sum(r['status']=='copied' for r in rows)==2
coll=[r for r in rows if r['status']=='collision_existing_destination']
assert len(coll)==1 and coll[0]['source_hex']=='706c61696e2e747874'
assert coll[0]['source_sha256']==expected[b'plain.txt'] and coll[0]['destination_sha256']==old_destination_hash
print('COLLISION_REPORT_SURVIVED_RESTART sha256=%s rows=3 copied=2 collisions=1' % hashlib.sha256(report_bytes).hexdigest())
inv=sha(base+b'/inventory.txt')
assert inv=='9ab4a43fd1f6762626066b004fa17d65daa3a6f7a8ea39f5e9721359d80dd99f'
print('SOURCE_TREE_PRESERVED entries=3')
print('INVENTORY_UNCHANGED sha256=%s' % inv)
print('POST_RESTART_STRICT_VERIFICATION=PASS')
PY
